newsitem.title: ITALY: ENI - MSCI market cap factor to rise.
newsitem.headline: ENI - MSCI market cap factor to rise.

text.p: Italian energy group ENI will see its market capitalisation factor on the Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) indices rise to 100 percent from 60 percent with effect from November 29, a MSCI announcemnt said.

"Following the recent placement of 14 percent of share capital, on top of the 15 percent stake placed last year, ENI will be included in the MSCI indices at full market capitalisation," the announcement said.
The Italian Treasury placed 15 percent of ENI shares in November 1995, and a further 14 percent last month.
The Morgan Stanley indicies are used by asset manangers who wish to invest in individual markets, like Italy, to reflect national stock market performances.
